# Missions split across several of the documents in sources.txt, which
# `make samples-check` also compiles together, as Yamcs loads them: a line
# "NAME:" names a mission, and the indented lines after it are its
# documents, those that others build on first.

# Yamcs's PUS example: data types, the PUS packets and its services.  The
# lander simulation (pus-landing.xml) builds on them too, but isn't valid
# XTCE, so it is left out.
pus:
    yamcs-examples/pus-dt.xml
    yamcs-examples/pus.xml
    yamcs-examples/pus5.xml
    yamcs-examples/pus11.xml
    yamcs-examples/pus17.xml
    yamcs-examples/pus19.xml
    yamcs-examples/pus20.xml
    yamcs-examples/pus22.xml
    yamcs-examples/pus23.xml

# The same example's PUS packets with their command verifiers.
pus-verifiers:
    yamcs-examples/pus-dt.xml
    yamcs-examples/pus-xtce-verif.xml

# cFS's CCSDS headers and the event service built on them.
cfs-evs:
    yamcs-cfs/cfs-ccsds.xml
    yamcs-cfs/CFE_EVS.xml
